title: 1D Gaussian Sustained Acquisition
intuition: Measures sustained acquisition of N(2, 0.5^2) over 1,000 updates requiring 5 consecutive terminal passing checks on mean error, standard-deviation ratio, and Kolmogorov-Smirnov CDF distance.
failure_mode: A transient pass followed by late-window width oscillation fails the 5-check sustained suffix gate.
